# Task M-10: a candidate must look like the song — a title floor, and stricter compilation paths

**Phase:** maintenance · **Depends on:** none · **Suggested tier:** Sonnet subagent · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal

Found on `ch01` (2026-10-10, song "Nine Days - Story of a Girl", MB recording `046c11b3-9787-49c1-a560-f7290bf36a0d`, 197.6 s, search run 519). Soulseek candidates from unrelated tracks were **accepted** and grabbed:

| remote path | duration | score | title points | artist points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `@@qmdmb\_3rd\_2309\Various Artists-2023-The Story Of Cadet Records (VMP Anthology Vinyl)-FLAC [24 192]\2. Dorothy Ashby (1968) Afro-Harping\04 Lonely Girl.flac` | 197 s | 689 | 80 / 200 | 0 |
| `@@qmdmb\_1st\_2305\Various Artists - Successful Story of a Bright Girl (명랑소녀 성공기) OST (2002) [FLAC]\09 - 사랑이 온거야.flac` | 199 s | 615 | 13 / 200 | 0 |

AcoustID rejected the first after download and the second timed out, so nothing wrong was imported, but each wrong grab costs a download, a blocklist entry and time. Two gaps in `src/Wondarr.Core/Decisions/DecisionEngine.cs`:

1. **There is no title floor.** A candidate is accepted whatever its title score, as long as nothing else rejects it.
2. **The artist rule is skipped for any path containing a compilation marker** (`ContainsCompilationMarker`, ~line 360), and the title words can then come from **folder** names ("The Story Of Cadet Records") rather than the file's own track title.

## Deliverables

1. **A title rejection** (`RejectionReason.TitleMismatch`, message `Title mismatch: '<file title>' does not match '<song title>'.`) when the candidate's own track title — parsed from the **file name** (track number, artist prefix and extension stripped; the existing `Parsed`/normaliser), not from folder names — is too far from the song's title. Pick the threshold from the golden set: it must reject both cases above and keep every currently-accepted golden case accepted. Version hints and `feat.` clauses are handled as the identity scorer already does, so "Absolutely (Story of a Girl)" vs "Story of a Girl" still matches (MusicBrainz lists both titles for the same song: treat a title that contains the song title as a whole parenthesised part, or the reverse, as a match).
2. **Stricter compilation paths.** When the artist rule is skipped because of a compilation marker, require the song's artist in the **file name** (or the candidate's parsed artist/tags) **or** a strong title match on the file name (a higher threshold than (1)); otherwise reject with `ArtistMismatch` ("Artist mismatch: a compilation path, and the file name names neither the artist nor the song closely enough."). `14 - Nine Days - Absolutely (story Of A Girl) (acoustic) - ….mp3` under `VA - ALBUMS VA\…` keeps passing the artist rule (it is still rejected for being acoustic).
3. **Score:** the title component is computed from the file-name title, not the whole path (check what the code does today and say in the done-report; change it only if it scores folder words).
4. **Golden cases:** add the two paths above (rejected), the acoustic VA path (artist rule passes, version rule rejects), and an ordinary `Nine Days\The Madding Crowd\02 Absolutely (Story of a Girl).flac` (title passes) to `tests/fixtures/decisions.json`; the existing golden cases must all keep their verdicts — report any that change and why. Unit tests for the file-name title extraction (Soulseek `\` and `/` paths, `NN - Artist - Title`, `NN. Title`, `Artist - Title`).
5. `docs/architecture/MATCHING_ENGINE.md` rejection table: the title rule and the compilation-path rule. `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` → `### Fixed`.

## Allowed paths

- `src/Wondarr.Core/Decisions/**`, `src/Wondarr.Core/Parsing/**` (or wherever the candidate normaliser lives — read only unless needed)
- `tests/Wondarr.Core.Tests/**`, `tests/fixtures/decisions.json`
- `docs/architecture/MATCHING_ENGINE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`

## Constraints

- No source-specific hack: the rules apply to every source (YouTube candidates carry a parsed title and artist, not a path — make sure they still pass as today; torrent/usenet file-list entries too).
- Keep `DecisionEngine` deterministic and fast (no I/O).

## Acceptance criteria

1. `dotnet build -warnaserror`; `dotnet test tests/Wondarr.Core.Tests` then `tests/Wondarr.Sources.Tests` then `tests/Wondarr.Api.Tests` (one at a time) — green.
2. The golden set passes with the new cases; a table in the done-report of any changed verdicts.
